name: Identity and Authentication
purpose: Owns identified actor profiles and bot authentication credentials while leaving conversation-scoped authority to membership.
justification: Identity status and bot credential validity form an application-wide authentication and attribution boundary governed independently of conversation-scoped roles, and credentials carry a stronger security posture than visible profiles.

dataObjects.name: Identity
dataObjects.purpose: Represents a stable non-anonymous person or bot profile and its application access status.

dataObjects.name: Bot Credential
dataObjects.purpose: Authenticates one bot identity through a revocable and optionally expiring retained token digest.

name: Tag Vocabulary
purpose: Owns canonical reusable tag values shared across conversations without owning conversation-specific assignments.
justification: Tags are shared identifiers owned by neither users nor conversations, with application-wide normalization and reuse rules distinct from the conversation-governed assignment of those values.

dataObjects.name: Tag
dataObjects.purpose: Stores a canonical case-insensitive value reused for conversation classification, discovery, and joining.

name: Conversations and Discovery
purpose: Owns conversation purpose, discovery and matching policy, lifecycle, and governed assignments of shared tags.
justification: Conversation owners and administrators govern discovery policy, lifecycle, and tag assignments under privacy and ownership-continuity rules distinct from shared vocabulary, participant authorization history, and authored content.

dataObjects.name: Conversation
dataObjects.purpose: Represents a tagged messaging space with discovery policy, purpose, and active or archived lifecycle.

dataObjects.name: Conversation Tag
dataObjects.purpose: Retains an ordered assignment between a conversation and a reusable tag, including removal history.

name: Membership and Authorization
purpose: Owns current and historical identity participation, roles, bans, ownership continuity, and conversation authorization evidence.
justification: Membership state is the conversation-scoped authorization boundary used by joining, viewing, posting, governance, and moderation, while temporal role and event history preserve authority after current state changes.

dataObjects.name: Membership
dataObjects.purpose: Stores the current retained relationship, participation state, and role for one identity in one conversation.

dataObjects.name: Membership Role Period
dataObjects.purpose: Preserves each time-bounded conversation role assignment for a membership.

dataObjects.name: Membership Event
dataObjects.purpose: Provides append-only evidence explaining each participation or role transition.

name: Messaging
purpose: Owns participant-authored conversation messages and retained emoji responses while relying on membership for authorization.
justification: Messages and reactions are authored interaction records with retention, soft-removal, chronological access, and content sensitivity distinct from permission history and case-oriented moderation evidence.

dataObjects.name: Message
dataObjects.purpose: Retains identified participant-authored conversation content and its soft-deletion visibility state.

dataObjects.name: Emoji Reaction
dataObjects.purpose: Retains an identity's emoji response to a message, including withdrawal state.

name: Moderation
purpose: Owns message reports, privileged review state, moderator action evidence, and time-bounded posting restrictions.
justification: Moderation is a conversation-scoped privileged trust boundary with case-specific sensitive evidence, authorized moderator writers, append-only action lineage, and sanction state used for permission decisions.

dataObjects.name: Moderation Ticket
dataObjects.purpose: Tracks a numbered participant report of a message and its privileged review state.

dataObjects.name: Moderation Action
dataObjects.purpose: Provides append-only evidence of a concrete action taken by an authorized conversation moderator.

dataObjects.name: Posting Suspension
dataObjects.purpose: Represents a moderator-imposed time-bounded posting restriction that leaves membership active.

name: Annotations
purpose: Owns identified user-authored contextual notes attached to conversations, messages, or moderation tickets.
justification: A Note crosses conversation, messaging, and moderation targets while retaining independent authorship, audience, and soft-deletion governance, creating a distinct security boundary from each target.

dataObjects.name: Note
dataObjects.purpose: Stores identified user-authored context attached to exactly one conversation, message, or moderation ticket.
